blocks.text: The El Niño phenomenon continues to drain the country’s agriculture sector, with losses inching up further past the P10-billion level, according to the Department of Agriculture (DA). In its bulletin on Friday evening, the DA said the farm sector incurred P10.44 billion in damage, 4.5 percent higher than the P9.99 billion reported by the agency
